hero.title: BBA / BBA (Hons.) Majoring in Business Psychology

panes.label: Overview
panes.text:
The BBA / BBA (Hons.) in Business Psychology at ATLAS ISME is designed for the next generation of business leaders who understand that people are the heart of every successful organisation. This interdisciplinary program bridges psychology and business, equipping you with the tools to master human behaviour, motivation and decision-making in corporate, entrepreneurial and global contexts.

You will explore how emotions, cognition, and social dynamics influence leadership, marketing, strategy, and innovation and learn to apply these insights to build stronger teams, brands and organisational cultures. Through experiential learning, case studies, industry projects and behavioural labs, you will develop the ability to design people-centric strategies, optimise performance and lead with empathy and evidence-based insight. By the end of the program, you’ll be ready to shape workplaces where people thrive alongside business success, driving organisational performance and growth.

cards.title: Understand core psychological theories and organisational applications
Design people-centred strategies for leadership and engagement
Apply founder psychology to drive entrepreneurial decision-making
Use people analytics to inform talent and performance strategy
Evaluate cross-cultural dynamics for effective collaboration
Integrate behavioural science and AI to enhance organisational performance
Marketing
cards.text: Go beyond the fundamentals of branding and consumer behaviour. The Marketing minor equips you to develop impactful campaigns, understand audience insights and build standout brands in today’s competitive landscape.

cards.title: Family Managed Business
cards.text: Develop expertise in governance, succession, strategy, finance and leadership within family enterprises. Prepare to lead, professionalise and sustain multi-generational businesses in an evolving global business environment.

cards.title: Finance
cards.text: Master key financial concepts, including investment, valuation, and budgeting, to drive organisational growth. The Finance minor prepares you for careers in corporate finance, banking and investment management.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: Transform ideas into action by learning to launch ventures and drive innovation. This minor sharpens your creativity, leadership and problem-solving through real-world projects and collaboration.

cards.title: Economics
cards.text: Explore the economic forces and policies shaping global businesses and markets. Learn how economic analysis informs decision-making and drives innovation through public policy.

cards.title: AI & Emerging Technologies
cards.text: Understand how AI, machine learning and emerging technologies are reshaping industries and driving innovation, efficiency and growth.

cards.title: Business Analytics
cards.text: Harness data to drive smarter business decisions. Learn to analyse trends, visualise information and use quantitative tools to impact marketing, finance, and strategy with data-driven insights.

cards.title: Digital Branding & Advertising
cards.text: Master digital marketing strategies, create compelling brand identities, and design effective campaigns to engage and grow online audiences.
